dross.trader.dialogue.intro: You've come about the rift? I don't believe you're strong enough. Show me. Bring me a skull from the Nether's fortresses, shards from the cities of the deep dark, and stone from the End.
dross.trader.dialogue.reminder_tributes: I am still waiting. Bring me: %1$s.
dross.trader.dialogue.reminder_key_mater: A key needs materials. Bring me: %1$s.
dross.trader.dialogue.accepted: Good. I will take that. Still needed: %1$s.
dross.trader.dialogue.not_enough: That is not enough. I need all of it at once: %1$s.
dross.trader.dialogue.already_have: I already have enough %1$s from you.
dross.trader.dialogue.not_yet: Not yet. Prove yourself with the three tributes first.
dross.trader.dialogue.tributes_complete: So you are stronger than you look. Take this compass: it points to the rift. I know how to forge a key to open it, but I need materials. Bring me: %1$s.
dross.trader.dialogue.key_forged: It is done. The key is yours. Use it at the rift, and be careful what you let out. I've got some books that can help you in there.
dross.trader.dialogue.key_replaced: Another key, then. Try not to lose this one.
dross.trader.dialogue.compass_replaced: You lost your compass? Here, take another. It will still point to the rift.
dross.trader.dialogue.lost_key: No key? I can forge you another, but it needs the same materials. Bring me: %1$s.

book.dross.weathered_letter.page1:
To whoever finds this,

You may have seen strange blue portals appear across your world, in shapes no one built.

They are rifts from the Dross, spilling over into ours.
book.dross.weathered_letter.page2_intro:
We have closed them, but the Dross is pressing to break through again. We need your help.

An old villager has made his home at the edge of a village, out from where the world began.
book.dross.weathered_letter.page2_intro_:
We have closed them, but the Dross is pressing to break through again. We need your help.

An old villager has made his home in an old chapel in the wilds, not far from where the world began.
book.dross.weathered_letter.page3: He is a friend of mine. He is looking for someone strong enough to help us fight back against the Dross.
book.dross.weathered_letter.location:
You will find him %1$s of where the world began, near X %2$s, Z %3$s, in an old chapel at the edge of the village.

Tell him an old friend sent you about the rift.

- A friend

book.dross.dross_guide_book.page1:
THE DROSS

A guide for those who stepped through the rift.

(Placeholder text: the full guide is still being written.)
book.dross.dross_guide_book.page2:
Where you are

The Dross is a land of endless night: dark forests, burning wastes and frozen peaks. The sun never rises here.

You arrived at the hub. Its portal leads back to the castle you came from.
book.dross.dross_guide_book.page3:
The hub

No monsters are born near the hub. It is the only safe ground in the Dross.

But they can still walk in from the dark.
book.dross.dross_guide_book.page4:
The dead

Zombies and skeletons here wear netherite. Their gear crumbles when they die.

Some carry forgotten knowledge: books of Deathforged.
book.dross.dross_guide_book.page5:
No way out

No portal can be lit inside the Dross. The hub's portal is the only way home.

Travel carefully.
dross.survivor.mentor.line.1: Footsteps I don't know. So the rift has let someone new through. Welcome to the Dross, traveller.
dross.survivor.mentor.line.2: No, I can't see you. I don't need to. You breathe like someone who has never been this far from the sun.
dross.survivor.mentor.line.3: The blue portal here is the only way home. Whatever you hear out there in the dark, remember the way back to it.
dross.survivor.mentor.line.4: The dead here wear netherite and never tire. We don't fight them. We outlast them.
dross.survivor.mentor.line.5: My student thinks I'm asleep when I stand still. I'm listening. The Dross hums before it moves.
dross.survivor.student.line.1: Oh! You're real. Sorry. Talk to enough rocks out here and you stop expecting answers.
dross.survivor.student.line.2: He can't see a thing, but he always knows where I am. I've tested this. Many times. Don't ask.
dross.survivor.student.line.3: He's teaching me to listen to the Dross. When the hum drops low, something's coming. So far I've mostly learned to run.
dross.survivor.student.line.4: How long have we been out here? I stopped counting the nights. It's hard when they never end.
dross.survivor.student.line.5: Whatever he tells you, listen. The one time I didn't, I spent a night up a dead tree, and he found me by the chattering of my teeth.

item.dross.moonsilver_spear.hint: Freezes what it hits. Throw it and it comes back.
dross.hunter_folk.spearman.line.1: Keep your blade low out here. The ice hears everything.
dross.hunter_folk.spearman.line.2: The Huntsman taught me the spear before I could walk the drifts.
dross.hunter_folk.spearman.line.3: Rimehorns charge if you stand downwind of them. Ask me how I know.
dross.hunter_folk.axeman.line.1: Wood is scarce this far out. Every cut counts.
dross.hunter_folk.axeman.line.2: Frostbitten logs split clean if you hit them before dawn.
dross.hunter_folk.axeman.line.3: Touch our stores and you'll meet the axe properly.
dross.hunter_folk.pikeman.line.1: A long reach keeps a moose's antlers far from your ribs.
dross.hunter_folk.pikeman.line.2: We hold the lanes when the skaters come in off the lake.
dross.hunter_folk.pikeman.line.3: Stand back a step. Further. Good.
dross.hunter_folk.archer.line.1: Skaters are fast on the ice. Lead them twice as far as you think.
dross.hunter_folk.archer.line.2: My arrows are fletched with lake ice. They fly true in the cold.
dross.hunter_folk.archer.line.3: If you hear me loose, don't stand between me and the noise.
dross.hunter_folk.hornblower.line.1: One blast calls the hunt. Two calls us home. Three, and you run.
dross.hunter_folk.hornblower.line.2: The Huntsman's horn is older than this village.
dross.hunter_folk.hornblower.line.3: Our flag has flown over every hunt since the first snow.
dross.hunter_folk.farmer.line.1: Frostroot likes the cold. It's the only thing out here that does.
dross.hunter_folk.farmer.line.2: Rimeberries are sweetest after a hard frost. Leave the green ones.
dross.hunter_folk.farmer.line.3: Mind the farmland. It took me a whole season to thaw it.
dross.hunter_folk.butcher.line.1: Nothing goes to waste here. Meat for the spit, bones for the arches.
dross.hunter_folk.butcher.line.2: One good Rimehorn feeds the whole village for a week.
dross.hunter_folk.butcher.line.3: Keep your hands clear of the block.
dross.hunter_folk.herder.line.1: The Rimehorns know my voice. They don't know yours.
dross.hunter_folk.herder.line.2: Snow Lichen for the moose, Rimeberries for the Rimehorns.
dross.hunter_folk.herder.line.3: Keep the pens shut, or they'll wander straight to the lake.
dross.hunter_folk.fisher.line.1: There's something big under the ice. It doesn't take bait.
dross.hunter_folk.fisher.line.2: Cut the hole small and wait. The lake gives when it wants to.
dross.hunter_folk.fisher.line.3: Stay off the open water. It's colder than it looks.
dross.hunter_folk.tanner.line.1: A good hide keeps you alive out here. A bad one just keeps you company.
dross.hunter_folk.tanner.line.2: Soak it, scrape it, stretch it, and let the cold finish it.
dross.hunter_folk.tanner.line.3: That's a fine coat you've got. Shame about the stitching.
dross.hunter_folk.elder.line.1: Welcome, traveller. Few come this deep into Rimefall, and fewer leave it.
dross.hunter_folk.elder.line.2: The Huntsman is our alpha. He rides the Alpha Moose, and nothing in Rimefall runs faster.
dross.hunter_folk.elder.line.3: We were hunters before the Dross took this land. We are hunters still.
dross.hunter_folk.elder.line.4: Above the lake, they say, an angel of snow keeps watch. We leave her offerings and ask for nothing.
dross.hunter_folk.elder.line.5: A Rimehorn took my eyes when I was young. I still hear them coming before you do.
dross.hunter_folk.elder.line.6: Raise a hand against my people and the whole village will answer. Keep the peace, and you'll have ours.
